title: The Regiment of Manchester's mill district
author: Sebastian Crane
blurb: Marguerite Sandoval, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
